fills.researcher_notes: ONE-QUESTION-PER-COMPANY: this is the operator answer for GSPL's own (non-JV) Gujarat grid, established once and applied identically across all 5 rows in this brief (P0927, P0937, P0905, P3909, P3910) — all five carry Owner1 = 'Gujarat State Petronet [100%]', not a joint-venture SPV, so the company-wide finding applies directly. Two genuinely independent origins converge: (1) CARE Ratings — an independent credit-rating agency, not GSPL itself — states plainly that GSPL 'owns and operates' its Gujarat network and separately that GSPL 'plans, designs, constructs, operates and maintains' its pipeline infrastructure, explicitly distinguishing this from the JV pipelines (GIGL/GITL/GEL) where GSPL is only a minority equity partner, not the operator; those JV-operated lines are NOT in this brief. (2) The PNGRB NGPL MIS register (the regulator's own line-wise register, independent of CARE) names GSPL as the authorisation holder for this specific pipeline (Sr. No. 13). The register's Owner [ref] fill for this row is already staged elsewhere (register-crosswalk batch, sheet_row 812) — I am not duplicating that fill, only citing the same register as one of two independent origins supporting Operator = Owner here, per the protocol's guidance that the register names the authorisation holder, which is usually but not always also the operator; CARE's explicit 'owns and operates' language is what closes that gap for GSPL's directly-held lines specifically. GSPL's own site (gspcgroup.com/GSPL) says the same but is first-party and not counted toward independence.
